Connect your iPay account. This app pays vendor bills straight from your iPay wallet, without leaving ERPNext. Each Company needs its own API credentials:
1. Log in to your iPay dashboard — new to iPay? Contact iPay there to get an account.
2. Generate your Client ID and Client Secret under API settings.
3. Add a row per Company below, paste them in, then Save and use Test Connection.
Leave Payment Account empty — it fills itself on Save (an "iPay" bank account is created in your Chart of Accounts for you).
Sandbox vs production is determined by the credentials and Base URL — there is no environment switch.
Questions? Contact support@doftwerks.com or visit doftwerks.com.
